verdict.rationale: A state business-filing and registry service could plausibly offer a programmatic API, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes web-portal applications (online filing, searches, certificate retrieval), fax filing and text/email notices. It never mentions a public API, much less one with parity to the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
